lead: Since 2012 I've been building websites, client portals and web services — design, Next.js development and SEO, from the first idea to launch.
content:
My experience covers a product's entire journey: analysis, interface design, development, SEO and support. That lets me bring the business goal, design and technology together into one coherent solution.

Over 14 years I've led a web department, spent five years running development in a product team, and since 2019 I've been building web apps on Next.js, APIs, client portals and design systems. My clients include logistics and law firms, a research institute of the Russian Academy of Sciences, messaging services, appraisers and manufacturers — more than 100 projects in total.

I'm an engineer by training, with a degree in computer systems and networks — and I also graduated from art school. The engineering side makes sure everything is fast and reliable; the art side makes sure it's a pleasure to use.

You work with me directly, with no account managers in between. I care that a website doesn't just look good on launch day but keeps bringing in customers for years, stays easy to update and doesn't need to be rebuilt.

items.title: The problem comes first
items.text: Before I open Figma, I find out why the website is needed, who will use it and how it will make money.

items.title: Honest about time and money
items.text: I give a realistic timeline and cost before we start. If the job can be done simpler and cheaper — say, with a website builder — I'll tell you.

items.title: No disappearing acts
items.text: I share work in progress on a staging address instead of going quiet for a month. You always know where the project stands.

items.title: No lock-in
items.text: I write clear code and leave documentation. If another team ever takes over, they won't have to rewrite everything.
SSR apps on Next.js, REST APIs, client portals and internal platforms, design systems and Figma prototypes.
Application and API architecture in a product team, corporate portals and client portals; led the UI/UX practice.
Ran the web development team and its processes, from strategy to release. Online stores, landing pages and B2B solutions.
Composition and visual thinking — the foundation UI/UX design is built on.

meta_title: Pavel Moiseev — full-stack web developer and designer
meta_description: Web developer and designer working since 2012: experience, education, how I work and my tech stack. More than 100 projects.
